dct_description_sm: This project is part of the Canadian IPY 2007-2009 project Seabirds as indicators of climate change. Adult murre stomach contents from Akpatok Island were quantified to compare with other dietary studies in the Arctic and historic studies at Akpatok Island. A number of body metrics were also recorded and several tissue samples have been entered into the National Specimen bank for each bird.
dct_title_s: Seabird diet as an indicator of change in the marine environment at Akpatok Island
